Class WordsTest

java.lang.Object
it.unipd.nonsense.utils.WordsTest
public class WordsTest extends Object
Test class for the abstract Words base class. This class verifies common dictionary functionality including:
  • Dictionary loading from files
  • Random word generation
  • Edge case handling
  • Error conditions

The class uses a test subclass of Words to test the abstract base class functionality. It creates temporary dictionary files for testing and cleans them up after tests complete.
